title: Srikaruda Naa Yesayya – Hosanna Ministries Telugu Christian Album Lyrics
intro: Srikaruda Naa Yesayya is the latest Telugu Christian album written, tuned and composed by Hosanna Ministries featuring Senior Pastors, Singer, song-writer, international speaker, Pastor John Wesley, Pastor Ramesh, Pastor Abraham & Pastor Freddy Paul. This album was released on March 03, 2022 through Hosanna Ministries YouTube channel.
